editorialCapacityRationale: A compact, single-building museum visit with a tightly connected collection: Renaissance castle interiors, the Danish royal lineage and furnishings, royal art and objects, crown jewels, and crown regalia. Twenty works/objects is sufficient to establish those core strands without padding the route with material from the wider Royal Danish Collection or other palaces.

collectionBoundaries.name: Rosenborg Castle building and permanent public displays
collectionBoundaries.location: Øster Voldgade 4A, 1350 Copenhagen, in Kongens Have
collectionBoundaries.scope: The castle interiors and rooms open to visitors, including the Treasury beneath the castle; the surrounding King's Garden is site context rather than part of the object pool.

collectionBoundaries.name: The Royal Danish Collection at Rosenborg / Danish Kings' Chronological Collection
collectionBoundaries.scope: Royal-history holdings and displays tied to Rosenborg: royal interiors and furnishings, paintings and portraits, clothing and other historical objects, crown jewels, crowns and crown regalia, with the historical sequence centered on the Danish kings represented at Rosenborg.

exclusions.name: The Hermitage Palace and Fredensborg Palace
exclusions.reason: Separate locations listed by the institution; neither is part of the Rosenborg Castle visit boundary.

exclusions.name: Kongens Have / King's Garden and the Royal Life Guard barracks
exclusions.reason: Adjacent site context or institutional surroundings, not the permanent Rosenborg museum object displays.

exclusions.name: Temporary exhibitions, calendar events, loan-only objects, and objects not confirmed as part of the permanent Rosenborg displays
exclusions.reason: This run establishes the stable museum and collection boundary; temporary or availability-dependent material requires later-stage confirmation and is not included in the base scope.

uncertainties: The Royal Danish Collection is a multi-venue institution, so an object or exhibition associated with the institution must be verified as Rosenborg-specific before entering the candidate pool.

The official site describes a Kingdom's Treasury project and a large historical-clothing collection; future or changing display areas should not be treated as permanently visible without later confirmation.
Collection scope is broader than what can be seen on one visit, and display availability may change; this scope does not assert that every Rosenborg-owned object is on view.
